raw_text: Read `README.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Stack: C++/MinGW, Go, TypeScript/React. Build: `npm run build`; test: `npm run test`; always test debug: `npm run build:interceptor:debug`. Zero dependencies; target Simple MAPI only; non-blocking, thread-safe; write JSON to `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`. Run `gofmt` before committing. Use TypeScript strict mode, React Bootstrap, no Tailwind; keep local-first/privacy-focused, offline-capable, cost-conscious, colocated/minimal files, translation-ready (i18n; technical docs English). Test Chrome/Edge, multiple apps, leaks, thread safety, filesystem errors, native messaging. Follow existing patterns; changes minimal; add tests; update docs/schema. Full validation: `npm run build`, `npm run test`; register DLL: `npm run register:mapi`; load extension developer mode; inspect `%TEMP%\go-mapi\` and DevTools. Preserve protocol/schema and update C++ writer, Go structs, TS types when fields change. Use Conventional Commits. Comment why, concise.
